title: The Fourth, from behind
logline: White fireworks over the dock, and on the shack steps, from behind: a back in plaid, the pup beside it. The first Fourth in the private pages; the first with him in it, as a back, two weeks into the sequence.

panels.composition: The dock at night under white fireworks seen from behind a man sitting on the shack steps in blue plaid with a small three-legged dog beside him; beyond, the family on the dock, the lawn chair, the ramp.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, white fireworks over a dock at night seen from behind a man in blue plaid flannel sitting on shack steps with a small three-legged dog beside him, a family on the dock beyond with an old lawn chair, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The first Fourth of Vol. II. A back on the steps.
